description: Kevel impression and custom-event pixels on e-{networkId}.adzerk.net/i.gif and /e.gif. Kevel documents e as the encoded shim and s as the signature. Click redirects on /r are not contracted.

params.name: e
params.description: It is the base64 encoded event shim. Kevel documents e as unique to the event.
params.fix_hint: Send e from the Decision API impressionUrl or events[].url. Do not invent it.

params.name: s
params.description: It is the signature that verifies the shim. Kevel documents s on every tracking pixel.
params.fix_hint: Send s from the same Decision API URL as e.

params.name: override
params.description: Kevel documents override as a monetary numeric event value.

params.name: additional
params.description: Kevel documents additional as a monetary numeric event value.

params.name: gmv
params.description: Kevel documents gmv as a monetary numeric event value.

params.name: productId
params.description: Kevel allows one to ten comma-separated productId strings on impression and custom-event URLs.

params.name: component
params.description: Kevel allows one to ten comma-separated component strings on impression and custom-event URLs.

params.name: position
params.description: Kevel allows one to ten comma-separated position strings on impression and custom-event URLs.

rules.message: Kevel limits the complete event URL query string to 1024 characters.
